narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To illustrate the relationship between educational attainment and Black migration rates from the South, highlighting the significance of 'some college' education in this trend since the 1960s.

units.meaning: Some college is the highest educational-attainment category by value/relative_value.

basis.note: maximum value among the four categories
maximum relative_value among the four categories

accepted_routes: Some college has the largest value, 27.
Some college is the top category, with relative_value 0.6525.
The tallest/largest bar is Some college.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The Some college mark must be visually identifiable as the largest/tallest/longest among the four categories.
units.temporal_anchor: the narration clause mentioning 'some college' or 'at least some college'
units.reviewer_question: Must the video explicitly identify Some college as the top category?

units.meaning: The four categories order from highest to lowest as Some college, College graduate, High school graduate, Less than high school.
accepted_routes: The categories rank as Some college > College graduate > High school graduate > Less than high school.
College graduate is second, High school graduate third, and Less than high school fourth.
The bars are ordered from Some college down to Less than high school.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The relative heights/lengths of all four categories must make the full rank order visible.
units.reviewer_question: Must the full rank order be conveyed, or is only the top category's position required?

units.meaning: Some college's value (27) is greater than College graduate's value (20), so the 'some college' category is the top category above 'college graduate'.
accepted_routes: Some college is higher than College graduate.
Some college exceeds College graduate by 7.
Some college is about 1.35 times College graduate.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The Some college bar must be visibly taller/longer than the College graduate bar.
units.reviewer_question: Should the video explicitly contrast Some college with College graduate as the top two categories?

units.meaning: Some college's value is three times High school graduate's value and nine times Less than high school's value.
accepted_routes: Some college is three times High school graduate.
Some college is nine times Less than high school.
High school graduate is three times Less than high school.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The High school graduate and Less than high school bars must be visibly much shorter than the Some college bar.
units.reviewer_question: Should the video quantify the gap between Some college and the lower two categories?

units.meaning: Less than high school is the lowest category, with value 3 and relative_value 0.0725.

basis.note: minimum value among the four categories
minimum relative_value among the four categories

accepted_routes: Less than high school is the smallest bar.
The lowest value is 3 for Less than high school.
Less than high school has the smallest relative_value, 0.0725.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The Less than high school mark must be visually identifiable as the smallest/shortest among the four categories.
units.reviewer_question: Should the video explicitly mark the lowest category?

optional_valid: Showing exact relative_value labels 0.6525, 0.4834, 0.2175, 0.0725 for the four categories.
Showing the exact difference of 7 between Some college and College graduate when the bars visibly show that gap.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal claims that some college education caused Black migration or that civil rights laws led to migration.
Any percentage, count, or migration-rate unit for the values, because the table's unit column is empty.
Time trend since the 1960s, because the table has no time dimension.
Treating relative_value as a share of the whole or summing it to 100%; the relative_values do not sum to 1.
Chart-type, color, axis-tick, or position-specific statements.
notes: The table has four educational attainment categories with absolute values and proportional relative_values; no unit or time column is populated. Units focus on ordering, extremes, and the counterintuitive Some college > College graduate comparison.
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
